title: Hodge theory proves the Heron-Rota-Welsh conjecture for matroids

items.meta_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 1511.02888: Hodge Theory for Combinatorial Geometries
passages: We use the Hodge-Riemann relations to resolve a conjecture of Heron, Rota, and Welsh that postulates the log-concavity of the coefficients of the characteristic polynomial of M.
We prove the hard Lefschetz theorem and the Hodge-Riemann relations for a commutative ring associated to an arbitrary matroid M.
We furthermore conclude that the f-vector of the independence complex of a matroid forms a log-concave sequence, proving a conjecture of Mason and Welsh for general matroids.

We use the Hodge-Riemann relations to resolve a conjecture of Heron, Rota, and Welsh that postulates the log-concavity of the coefficients of the characteristic polynomial of $\mathrm {M}$.
We furthermore conclude that the $f$-vector of the independence complex of a matroid forms a log-concave sequence, proving a conjecture of Mason and Welsh for general matroids.

items.title_found: A semi-small decomposition of the Chow ring of a matroid
items.meta_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2002.03341: A semi-small decomposition of the Chow ring of a matroid
passages: The decomposition is used to give simple proofs of Poincaré duality, the hard Lefschetz theorem, and the Hodge-Riemann relations for the Chow ring, recovering the main result of [AHK18].
We give a semi-small orthogonal decomposition of the Chow ring of a matroid M.
We also show that a similar semi-small orthogonal decomposition holds for the augmented Chow ring of M.
